sources.excerpt: The 122nd edition of the World Series, the best-of-seven playoff series was played from October 23 to 28 by the American League (AL) champion Tampa Bay Rays and the National League (NL) champion Milwaukee Brewers, who defeated the Rays in five games to win their first championship.
Milwaukee closed the series in Game 5, maintaining another early lead to win 4–1 and clinch their first title.
Brewers catcher William Contreras was named the World Series Most Valuable Player (MVP) after batting .381 and going 10-for-13 on Automated Ball-Strike System (ABS) challenges in the series.

In October 2026, DoorDash announced plans to acquire Instacart in a $17 billion deal, offering $65 per share. The deal would expand DoorDash's grocery delivery services and give Instacart customers access to more than 50,000 additional stores.
The companies expect the deal to be finalized in late 2027 or early 2028.

Canada's federal government invests up to C$1.6 billion (US$1.1 billion) in Toronto-based artificial intelligence company Cohere, taking an equity stake as part of a C$7 billion (US$5 billion) funding round intended to expand domestic computing infrastructure and AI development.

A single ancient elephant tooth is offering scientists a remarkable glimpse into a world that existed nearly 700,000 years ago. Found in northern Israel, the fossil has helped researchers reconstruct a surprisingly lush prehistoric landscape.
The fossils belonged to Palaeoloxodon antiquus, commonly known as the straight-tusked elephant.

Elephant remains were unearthed alongside handaxes and cleavers made from basalt, a volcanic rock. These implements belong to the Acheulian tradition, one of the oldest and most widespread stone tool technologies in human history.
